drafts.title: I collected 80 dev stack descriptions and fed them to an AI roaster. 43% were running Kubernetes for <500 users.
drafts.content:
Spent the last few weeks gathering stack descriptions from Reddit and Discord and running them through an AI architecture roaster. The six patterns it kept flagging (distributed monolith, Kafka for tiny workloads, framework churn, etc.) were so consistent it was eerie.

Full writeup with the AI's actual quotes:

https://tinytools-smoky.vercel.app/roast-my-stack/blog/i-made-ai-roast-my-tech-stack-called-kubernetes-devops-larping-2026/

Tool itself is free: https://tinytools-smoky.vercel.app/roast-my-stack/

Unpopular opinion: most "microservices" I've reviewed are distributed monoliths with 4x the operational complexity and 0x the benefits.

I ran 80 stack descriptions through an AI roaster this month. 22 of the 31 "microservices" stacks shared a database or called each other synchronously on every request. That's not microservices — that's a monolith you can't deploy without a ceremony.

The hardest part of architecture isn't choosing the right tools. It's being honest about what stage you're actually at.

Full breakdown of the 6 patterns (free tool included):
https://tinytools-smoky.vercel.app/roast-my-stack/blog/i-made-ai-roast-my-tech-stack-called-kubernetes-devops-larping-2026/

I kept rationalizing our burn. "We're in growth mode." "The unit economics will catch up."

Built a tool that just... does the math and says what it means plainly. Entered my own numbers. Got called a "professional runway tourist." Accurate.

No login, no email — just MRR, monthly burn, cash in bank → a financial roast and shareable card.

Link: tinytools-smoky.vercel.app/saas-burn-roast/

Curious what others get — post your roast label if you try it.

Unpopular opinion: most founders know their burn rate is a problem. They just haven't seen it described in language that makes it real.

I built a free tool that roasts your SaaS burn the way a blunt CFO friend would — not with a clean dashboard, but with the specific, uncomfortable sentence your numbers actually deserve.

Mine: "You are not default alive. You are default dependent on fundraising conditions that may not exist in 6 months."

That sentence changed my week. Maybe your numbers are fine. But you should find out: tinytools-smoky.vercel.app/saas-burn-roast/
